info.name: Maham Customer API v1
info.description:
# Maham Customer API (v1)

**Base URL**: `{{base_url}}` (local: `http://maham.test/api/v1`)

## Headers on every request
- `Accept: application/json`
- `Accept-Language: ar` or `en` (messages, validation errors and content come back in this language)
- `Authorization: Bearer {token}` on protected endpoints

## Response format
Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {...} }`

Error: `{ "success": false, "message": "first error to show the user", "errors": { "field": ["..."] } }`

Status codes: 200 OK, 401 not logged in / token expired, 403 forbidden, 404 not found, 422 validation error, 429 too many requests / OTP resend too soon, 503 SMS provider down.

## Registration flow & next_step
Every auth response contains `next_step`. Open the screen for that value:
- `verify_phone` -> Phone number screen (Google/Apple users: use **Phone (social users)** endpoints)
- `personal_details` -> Tell us about yourself
- `credentials` -> Secure your account (email + password)
- `verify_email` -> Verify Email OTP sheet
- `address` -> Where should we find you?
- `profile_image` -> Add a profile photo
- `completed` -> Home
- `guest` -> Home in guest mode

If the user closes the app mid sign-up, call `GET /auth/me` on launch and open the `next_step` screen.

## Phone numbers
Send any Saudi format: `0512345678`, `512345678` or `+966512345678`. The API returns `phone` as `512345678` and `phone_country_code` as `+966`.

## OTP
**Demo account (local)**: demo@maham.sa / Demo1234 / phone 0500000001.

4 digits, valid 5 minutes, resend after 60 seconds (values also returned by `/app/config`). **On the local/staging server the OTP is always `1234`.**

request.description:
Call on the Splash screen.

- `data.update`: `force` = block the app and open `versions.{platform}.store_url`; `optional` = show "update available"; `none` = continue.
- `data.maintenance_mode`: show maintenance screen when true.
- `data.languages`: options for the Choose language screen (`direction` rtl/ltr).
- `data.otp`: OTP length and timers.

The chosen language is kept on the device and sent as `Accept-Language` on every request.

request.description:
OTP sheet -> Verify. On success shows "Phone Verified".

Returns `token` (saved automatically in Postman) + `next_step`. Use this token for all next steps.

`device_name`, `fcm_token`, `platform` are optional (for push notifications).

request.description:
Home screen in one call:
- `address` -> header text (district + city). `null` if the user has no address.
- `unread_notifications_count` -> show the green dot on the bell when > 0.
- `show_become_provider` -> show the "Become a service provider" card.
- `popular_services` -> Popular Services grid. Tap **View All** -> `GET /services`.

response.name: Success

Home screen in one call:
- `address` -> header text (district + city). `null` if the user has no address.
- `unread_notifications_count` -> show the green dot on the bell when > 0.
- `show_become_provider` -> show the "Become a service provider" card.
- `popular_services` -> Popular Services grid. Tap **View All** -> `GET /services`.
